package loadtest

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	generated "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest/protocol"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/msgid"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/action"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/protocol"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/scenario"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/session"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
)

// Smoke 验证新房间的第一个合法动作、同连接重试、重连后重试都只提交一次。
// 这是功能验收；重复同一回执不代表正常业务吞吐，不能用其结果声明服务器容量。
func Smoke(cfg runner.Config, roomID int64, auth robot.AuthProvider) *runner.Runner {
	protocols := protocol.NewRegistry(nil)
	generated.RegisterDefaults(protocols)
	scenarios := scenario.NewRegistry()
	actions := action.NewRegistry()
	command := scenario.NodeFunc(func(ctx context.Context, rb *robot.Context) error {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		message, err := rb.Session().CallChecked(ctx, msgid.MsgScenarioCommand, msgid.MsgScenarioCommand, &pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: roomID, Seq: 1, Kind: FIRST_COMMAND}, func(m *session.Message) error {
			response, ok := m.Value.(*pb.ScenarioCommandResponse)
			if !ok {
				return fmt.Errorf("invalid command response")
			}
			if response.Code != 0 {
				return session.ErrRejected
			}
			return nil
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		response, ok := message.Value.(*pb.ScenarioCommandResponse)
		if !ok || response.Code != 0 || response.Revision != 1 || response.Reward != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("unexpected command result: %#v", message.Value)
		}
		return nil
	})
	scenarios.MustRegister(scenario.New("smoke", scenario.Sequence(
		scenario.Action(action.NameConnect, nil), command, command,
		scenario.Action(action.NameConnect, nil), command,
	)))
	cfg.Scenario = "smoke"
	cfg.Transport.Type = transport.PlayerTCPType
	return runner.New(cfg, runner.WithProtocolRegistry(protocols), runner.WithScenarioRegistry(scenarios), runner.WithActionRegistry(actions), runner.WithAuthProvider(auth))
}
